title: The Lantern Moth
statement: Long ago, when the sky was still unfinished, a small moth mistook the first star for a lantern and flew toward it for a thousand years, only to learn the light was never meant to be caught, just followed. The gods, charmed by her stubborn curiosity, stitched her into the dark with seven stars for her wings, one faint ember for the question she carries, and each night she traces her path again and flutters, briefly, when someone looks up and wonders.
